department: Department of Biomedicine (Graduate Programme in Biomedicine, Graduate School of Health)

deadline.value: The next ordinary open call closes 25 Feb 2027 (Spring 2027 round, earliest start 1 June 2027). The Autumn 2026 round closed 3 Sep 2026.

app_fee.value: The Graduate School of Health pages checked do not state an application fee.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School of Health pages checked do not mention a fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School of Health pages checked do not mention the GRE General test.

gre_subject.value: The Health pages checked do not mention a subject GRE.

toefl_min.value: For Health, TOEFL iBT results from after 21 January 2026 need 4.5 (new scale), with at least 4.0 in each subscore.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum test score for test results from after 21 January 2026 is 4.5 with at least 4.0 in each subscore.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6 in each subscore.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum test score required is 6.5 with at least 6 in each subscore.

english_waiver.value: A master's taught in English does not count; a listed English test or English B from Danish upper secondary is needed.
english_waiver.quote: No other tests or kind of documentation are accepted (this includes that you master's degree was taught in English)

supervisor.value: You must have a Faculty of Health main supervisor, and their recommendation must be part of the application.
supervisor.quote: You must have a main supervisor from the Faculty of Health, and a recommendation from your main supervisor is a mandatory part of your application

funding.value: Ordinary open calls offer enrolment with or without a fellowship; about 10 fully financed fellowships are offered each round.
funding.quote: Ca. 10 fully financed PhD fellowships are offered each round.

entry_route.value: Access requires a Danish master's degree of 120 ECTS or a similar five-year degree; foreign degrees are assessed first.
entry_route.quote: Access to the graduate school’s PhD programme requires a Danish Master’s degree

notes: Health applicants apply to an ordinary open call with a main supervisor's recommendation. The Health override fields are toefl_min and english_waiver; the Health fee and waiver are not stated on pages checked. Public Health and ClinFO are not STEM and are not saved.
